changelog: **Board:** the per-card stage picker is an icon in the card's meta row instead of a full-width field under every card — it cost a 44px row per card and repeated the name of the column the card already sits in. The native `<select>` is still there (transparent, over the icon), so the touch and keyboard alternative to drag-and-drop and its accessible name are unchanged (`CardStageSelect`, both boards).

en: Board cards are more compact: the stage picker is now a small icon on the card instead of a full-width field.
tr: Pano kartları daha derli toplu: aşama seçici artık kartın altındaki geniş alan yerine kart üzerinde küçük bir ikon.
de: Board-Karten sind kompakter: Die Phasenauswahl ist jetzt ein kleines Symbol auf der Karte statt eines Feldes über die volle Breite.
